notAssessed: Not assessed yet. Press “Assess this job” so your agent assesses it.
stale: From an earlier calculation: the profile or the job changed.
staleScore: Assessed with a fit of {{was}}; it is now {{score}} because the profile or the job changed.

notes.off: The app only recognises your skills when they're named as in the job: it misses synonyms and similar phrases, like “ETL” and “data pipelines”.
notes.notInstalled: Meaning-based comparison isn't on: it's optional and the guide explains how to turn it on.
notes.unavailable: Right now the app only recognises your skills when they're named as in the job: it misses synonyms and similar phrases.
notes.failed: Couldn't compare synonyms ({{error}}): the app only recognises your skills when they're named as in the job.
notes.noMust: The job doesn't say which skills are required, so that part doesn't count in the fit.
notes.noNice: The job doesn't say which skills are nice-to-have, so that part doesn't count in the fit.

belowAssessThreshold: Your agent doesn't assess it in the background: its fit ({{score}}) is below the minimum ({{threshold}}). Change it on the “Agent” page or assess it “In a terminal”.
salaryGap: {{amount}} below your minimum (only you see this).

semantic.learnMore: What it adds and how to turn it on
semantic.title: Meaning-based comparison
semantic.intro: Right now the fit compares your skills with the job's by name only. With this option it also compares the meaning of your profile (headline, summary and achievements) with the job (title, responsibilities, skills and sector), even when they use different words.

benefits.synonyms: Spots the fit even when the words differ: “data pipelines” and “ETL”, “reporting dashboards” and “Power BI”.
benefits.languages: Works across languages: compares a job in English with your profile in Spanish.
benefits.fewSkills: Scores better the jobs that list few skills or unusual names, where comparing names falls short.
benefits.weight: Fills in the “Similarity” part of “Where the number comes from”, worth 30% of the fit. Without it, that weight is spread across the other parts.

semantic.local: It runs on your computer: your profile never leaves it. Only the model is downloaded, once.
semantic.permanent: It is permanent: it is used for every job from the moment it is installed. Open jobs are recalculated when it finishes (their fit may shift a few points) and closed ones when you open them. If you update the app, it reinstalls itself.
semantic.size: It downloads a few hundred MB (much more on Linux) and takes 1-2 GB of disk. It takes a few minutes; you can keep using the app meanwhile.
semantic.docker: Not available in Docker: the image does not include it. The fit is calculated the same without it.

off.title: Meaning-based comparison: off
off.body: Right now the fit only counts your skills by their name. Turn it on so it also compares the meaning of your profile with each job.

installing.title: Installing meaning-based comparison…
installing.body: It is being downloaded and installed in the background: it takes a few minutes and you can keep using the app. When it finishes, the fit of open jobs is recalculated on its own.

failed.title: Meaning-based comparison could not be installed
failed.body: The fit is still calculated, by skill names only. See the error and try again.

installed.title: Meaning-based comparison: on
installed.body: The fit also compares the meaning of your profile with each job, even when they use different words.

disabled.title: Meaning-based comparison: turned off
disabled.body: It is installed, but turned off in your settings.

docker.title: Meaning-based comparison: not available
docker.body: It cannot be installed in Docker: the image does not include it. The fit is calculated the same without it.

score.active: With meaning-based comparison: your profile (headline, summary and achievements) and this job are {{pct}}% alike. It counts in the breakdown's “Similarity”.

off.title: Fit without meaning-based comparison
off.body: Right now it only counts your skills by name. Install it and the fit also compares the meaning of your profile with the job, for a finer fit.

failed.title: Fit without meaning-based comparison
failed.body: The installation failed, so the fit only counts your skills by name. See the error and try again for a finer fit.

scoreHint: From 0 to 100, how close the job is to your profile, above all in the required skills. From {{threshold}} it is a possible fit; from {{high}}, a good fit. Below {{threshold}}, “To review” shows it dimmed.
scoreHintPlain: From 0 to 100, how close the job is to your profile, above all in the required skills.

component.must_have_coverage: How many of the job's required skills are in your profile, and at what level. It weighs the most.
component.semantic_similarity: How close what your profile says is to what the job asks for, even in different words.
component.preferences_fit: Whether the kind of role, work mode and area match your preferences.
component.nice_to_have_coverage: How many of the job's nice-to-have skills you have.

componentPoints: Here it adds {{points}} of the {{max}} points it can give.
componentOff: It doesn't count: it needs meaning-based comparison. Its points are spread across the other parts.
